o: After Camp Half-Blood's protective border is breached, Percy Jackson embarks on an epic odyssey into the Sea of Monsters in search of his best friend, the satyr Grover Underwood, and the one thing that may save the camp — the legendary Golden Fleece. Aided by demigods Annabeth Chase and Clarisse La Rue, along with his cyclops half-brother Tyson, Percy's survival becomes the key to preventing…

eps.o: Percy, Annabeth, and Tyson race to defend Camp Half-Blood from dangerous forces.
Percy and Annabeth contend with a new activities director as they try to locate Grover.
Aboard a cruise ship, our heroes struggle to differentiate friend from foe.
Quests collide as our crew voyages into the perilous Sea of Monsters.

eps.t: We Check In to C.C.'s Spa & Resort
eps.o: Percy and Annabeth must confront their flaws at a resort sanctuary.
